description.narrative: Specifically, in the first 9 months (RVO-funded), the project will aim to achieve the following 4 objectives: Objective 1: Establish a solid presence in Senegal through office registration, office set-up, and staff recruitment. Objective 2: Onboarding the CAC model and selecting cooperatives through scoping and assessments. Objective 3: Strengthening the capacity of supported cooperatives in governance, management, and business planning through training and tailored advisory services. Objective 4: Project learning, land rights regime, and associated environmental and social impacts.

The Strengthening Farmer Organisations in Senegal program funded by RVO is Agriterra’s approach to kick-start its work in Senegal to strengthen agricultural cooperatives, including the recently established model "Coopérative Agricole Communale" (CAC) in Diender. Agriterra proposes to support 15 farmer cooperatives between 2025 and 2030. This RVO project covers the first 9-month period in 2025-2026, to ensure Agriterra can set up its operations as well as scope, assess and start building the capacity of 5 cooperatives, including 1 CAC. The RVO-funded project is the foundation for its longer-term activities in Senegal under FFT2, funded by DGIS. The second phase of FFT is a five-year initiative designed to strengthen the role of farmer organisations as central drivers of inclusive and sustainable agricultural transformation. Within this programme, Agriterra positions farmer organisations as agents of systemic change.

transaction.ref: Incoming Commitment RVO for Strengthening Farmer Organisations in Senegal
